name: king_cobra_strike
description: King cobra (Ophiophagus hannah): heavy olive #6b7a3a body, darker olive back #4f5a2a, thin pale cream chevron bands #e8e0a8 pointing toward the head and fading toward it, pale yellow throat #e8d890, large smooth head shields, small dark eye under a heavy brow, NARROW hood (barely wider than the neck; never the wide Naja disc). Front third raised and lunging right with the mouth wide open (pink-grey lining, two fangs), rest of the body on the ground behind. Anchor bottom-centre; bbox x -450..+433, y -319..0; open mouth about (+430,-262).
